author: Gaetan Chenevier
work: The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
theorem_locators: Section 1.22, printed pages 18-19, Cayley-Hamilton quotient and arbitrary base change
precise_import: A Cayley-Hamilton determinant over a henselian local ring with split absolutely irreducible residual determinant is the full matrix determinant. The coefficient-defined CH quotient commutes with base change.
hypotheses_checked: R is the original completed local B_p, hence henselian.
NP.span with a=n and the original surjection h.p0 spans all Mat_n(F).
The residual determinant is literally det(rho_x composed h.p0) by OoPt.maps.
n>=1 by NP.a_pos; the quotient is the universal multivariable CH quotient.
The original GDet is a natural homogeneous multiplicative polynomial law on all commutative scalar algebras; CH coefficients match its universal CH ideal.
There is no n! assumption, so n=4 and ell=3 are included.
human_proof_use: CRW3; CRW4-CRW6 independently add exact polarization, finite original-B continuity, closure killing and every-field quotient/NonSS.
excluded_scope: No ordinary/control, automorphic, S4 or patched-module existence theorem is imported.

precise_import: Localizations and finite-variable formal power-series rings over a Noetherian ring are Noetherian.
hypotheses_checked: O and OO are DVRs and hence Noetherian.
Only one or D0 finitely many formal variables are used.
B is Noetherian by the original IsCO record.

precise_import: A complete separated local ring is henselian.
hypotheses_checked: R is the maximal-ideal completion of the actual Noetherian local B_p and is complete and separated.

precise_import: For finite modules M contained in P0 over Noetherian B, some fixed c gives M intersect m^(j+c)P0 contained in m^j M.
hypotheses_checked: B is the original Noetherian local ring.
P0 is generated by n^2 trace-dual matrices over B.
M is its submodule spanned by group matrices, hence is finite.
The ideal is exactly m_B, not the completion ideal p.

precise_import: The intersection of m_B^j M is zero for finite M over Noetherian local B.
hypotheses_checked: M is the one finite B-algebra constructed in CRW5.
m_B is proper and B is local Noetherian.

precise_import: Noetherian local completion is complete Noetherian local, faithfully flat, and has unchanged quotients by maximal-ideal powers.
hypotheses_checked: The local rings are B_p and O[[S]]_(varpi), or the retained actual Noetherian patched quotient localized at its specified prime.
Every completion is at that local maximal ideal; it lies in the Jacobson radical.
CRW11 uses only the quotient modulo the square of that maximal ideal.

precise_import: The maximal-ideal completion of a Noetherian local DVR is a DVR.
hypotheses_checked: CRW2 proves O[[S]]_(varpi) is a DVR by coefficient valuation.
Noetherianity follows from CRW_NOETHERIAN.

precise_import: For a Noetherian local ring, dimension is the least number of generators of an ideal of definition; hence it is at most the number of maximal-ideal generators.
hypotheses_checked: OO[[Z_1,...,Z_D0]] is local and Noetherian.
Its maximal ideal is generated by the OO uniformizer and D0 variables.
CRW18 proves the reverse inequality by an explicit chain of prime ideals.
